Theorem
[matrix Li–Yau–Hamilton estimate] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 2.5.4\group Cao–Zhu Li-Yau-Hamilton Estimates Let $g_{ij}(x,t)$ be a complete solution with bounded curvature to the Ricci flow on a manifold $M$ for $t$ in some time interval $(0,T)$ and suppose the curvature operator of $g_{ij}(x,t)$ is nonnegative. Then for any one-form $W_a$ and any two-form $U_{ab}$ we have \[ M_{ab}W_aW_b+2P_{abc}U_{ab}W_c+R_{abcd}U_{ab}U_{cd}\geq 0 \] on $M\times (0,T)$.
